text:
maria-sdk: quick note — new starter kit fails when deployed to our edge preview. error: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'". repro steps in README but seems tied to package.json "type" + bundler config.
daniel.build: can you paste package.json + tsconfig + build command? that usually narrows it down.
maria-sdk: package.json: { "type": "module" } tsconfig has module: esnext, moduleResolution: node, target es2021. build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/worker.js --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020
tia-dx: iife + module:type=module combination can be a mismatch. If esbuild leaves an `export` in a module wrapper, the edge runtime (which expects an ESM or pure script) chokes. Try `--format=esm` for edge builds.
daniel.build: yep. Another trap is package export maps and conditions. If your dev machine resolves the sdk to cjs during local dev but the bundle picks import conditions during CI you get inconsistent artifacts. What does node resolve to in your environment?
maria-sdk: locally `node -v` is 18, developer machines default to cjs in a few cases. The SDK publishes both dist/cjs and dist/esm with package.json exports, but our sample's bundler ended up leaving `import`/`export` tokens because we used `format: iife` which wraps modules but doesn't transpile ESM syntax by default.
tia-dx: for sample apps we should add a tiny doc: "Edge build: use format=esm + target=es2020 OR bundle to iife and set loader to transform es modules". Also mention `moduleResolution: node16` in tsconfig to match Node/ESM semantics.
daniel.build: on the typing side: several users reported weird inference loss when calling client.request<T>(). I tracked it to our retry wrapper which currently types as `function withRetries(fn: () => Promise<any>): Promise<any>` — that kills inference.
maria-sdk: oh yikes. any makes everything fall back. can we just make it generic: `function withRetries<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>` and thread that through?
daniel.build: yes. But also watch for overloads like `request<T=any>(opts: Options<T>): Promise<T>` + `request(opts: Options<any>)`. The `=any` default plus an overload that accepts any will confuse inference for callers omitting the generic. `unknown` default is safer and overloads should be minimized.
tia-dx: we should add a tsd test in the repo asserting `const r = await client.request<{id:number}>({})` results in `r.id` having type number (i.e., a compile-time check). Add that to CI for the sdk package.
maria-sdk: agreed. Also for the starter template: set skipLibCheck: true to reduce noisy errors for newcomers. But keep an issue to fix d.ts in the SDK rather than relying on skipLibCheck forever.
daniel.build: another subtle one: bundlers sometimes rewrite conditional exports to prefer `import` paths. If your package.json has "exports" fine-grained, ensure dist/esm entry is actually ESM and not CJS-ish. We've seen packages export ESM wrappers that re-export CJS causing runtime issues.
tia-dx: for the docs update: add a short checklist under "Edge deployment":
  - package.json: note on "type" and exports map
  - tsconfig: recommend moduleResolution=node16, module=esnext
  - esbuild: for edge prefer format=esm or ensure esbuild target transpiles exports
  - runtime: preview/edge expects ESM semantics; avoid bundling that leaves raw export tokens
  - tip: if you need universal bundle, bundle sdk into the final file (no external resolution)
maria-sdk: I'll open three PRs: (1) typing fix — remove any defaults, use unknown and generic retry wrapper + tsd tests, (2) starter template change: skipLibCheck true + updated tsconfig snippet, (3) sample README edits with esbuild examples for node vs edge. pinging @daniel.build for review on typings.
daniel.build: happy to review. One more recommendation: include a small CI job that runs the sample through the real edge preview (emulator) after build to catch these runtime mismatches early.
tia-dx: +1. Finally, we should update changelog with migration notes: users who relied on `any`-based overloads might have to add explicit generics (but inference should work with the new signatures).
ci-bot: ci/sample-edge-run queued for execution (triggered by maria-sdk/sample-edge-fixes).
... (later) ...
maria-sdk: opened PRs and added tsd test. reworked retry wrapper to `withRetries<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>` and updated public d.ts. local tsd passes. will wait on review then merge.
daniel.build: great. once merged we can roll this into the starter template release. thanks for the quick turnaround.
